title: Independently check #4436 §3 on raw p7: width factor, exact routing-slot identity, N log N growth (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/direct-flow-width-check/`. It is an independent check of zxv's #4436 §3 (nested widths and complete count bounds) on raw p7. That section was left uncovered by my #4456, whose flow implementation this reuses.

**Claim type:** an independent finite check plus an exact counting identity. **No new κ.**

## Results (every rank 121 ≤ n ≤ 2000)

- **Width factor.** `S_n ≤ C = W(W+P+1)^{h+1}`, with `W = 7688` and `P = 55998`. The worst `S_n/C` is `1.6·10⁻⁵`.
- **New exact identity.** `sources + exits + 2·matched = U(W+P)`. So #4436's routing count equals `2(W+P)U − 2·matched` exactly, and is at most `2(W+P)U`.
- **Growth.** `log B_N/(N log N)` is 1.09, 1.76, 1.96 and 2.03 at `N` = 500, 1,000, 1,500 and 2,000, and 2.07 at 3,000 locally. That is consistent with `exp(O(N log N))`, with a constant near 2.

## Evidence

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/direct-flow-width-check --check-only
  PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/direct-flow-width-check
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/direct-flow-width-check outcome=completed
```
